description: This file contains a test class 'LivenessTests_ZK' for testing the liveness and membership functionality of an Orleans cluster configured with ZooKeeper as the clustering provider. It includes setup for ZooKeeper, configuration of silos, and multiple test methods that verify different liveness scenarios.

classes.name: LivenessTests_ZK
classes.description: A test class inheriting from 'LivenessTestsBase' that contains tests related to ZooKeeper-based cluster liveness.

methods.name: LivenessTests_ZK
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test class.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides base method to configure the test cluster with ZooKeeper and starts the ZooKeeper service if necessary.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_1
methods.description: A test method for basic liveness verification with ZooKeeper.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_2_Restart_Primary
methods.description: A test method for restarting the primary silo and verifying liveness.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_3_Restart_GW
methods.description: A test method for restarting the gateway and verifying cluster liveness.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_4_Restart_Silo_1
methods.description: A test method for restarting a specific silo and verifying the cluster continues to function.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_5_Kill_Silo_1_With_Timers
methods.description: A test method for killing a silo with timers and checking cluster resilience.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster, ensuring ZooKeeper is running and configures the silo to use ZooKeeper clustering.
